package: K38 bounded HTML/thumbnail preflight and fixed-count guest identity
scope: One-shot preflight and runner-contract changes only; no k6 load or application traffic was run in verification.

contract.target_restriction: HTTP numeric loopback only (127.0.0.1, ::1); redirects refused
contract.read_strategy: incremental read1 chunks up to 8192 bytes, stop at limit plus one byte
contract.home: HTTP 200, HTML MIME, <html marker within bounded prefix
contract.thumbnail: HTTP 200, image MIME, supported PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/AVIF signature matches MIME
contract.measured_k6: HTML/image bodies remain discarded during measured k6 traffic
contract.profile: records base URL, Host, locale, SHA-256 of video ID, probe runner/applicability, bound, result filename, and helper source SHA-256
contract.fixed_count: shares OUT_DIR lock and guest User-Agent identity with rate-series runner; both pass matching BASE/Host/locale to k6

fixture: Synthetic Node HTTP server on 127.0.0.1; valid large HTML/WebP prefix accepted within bound, invalid HTML/JPEG signature and redirect rejected; external URL rejected before network access.
limitations: No app, database, k6, Docker, server, proxy, load or production traffic.
No full HTML parsing, image decoding, cache verification, playback or capacity evidence.
Non-production acceptance and cleanup remain open; K38 is partial.
